lf-swipe-deck.description: A rapid pass-or-keep classification Ask, answered when no unseen cards remain.
lf-swipe-deck.x-instructions: Put the deck inside lf-ask, whose heading names it. Keep classified cards in the piles the user chose across revisions unless the revision restates them. A rewrite that invalidates a classification restates the card; one that invalidates the completed deck restates the deck. Read authoring-revisions.md, Honor user state, and $restated.

lf-swipe-pile.description: One verdict pile in a swipe deck: unseen, pass, or keep.
lf-swipe-pile.x-instructions: Use unseen for the ordered queue, pass for excluded proposals, and keep for retained follow-up. A card's pile supplies its classification; do not add a duplicate status to the card.

lf-swipe-card.description: One concise proposal the user can classify in a swipe deck.
lf-swipe-card.x-instructions: Lead with a `<strong>` title and enough prose to classify it without leaving the deck. Keep its id stable across versions. Rewriting a classified proposal needs restated on this card.
